definition.simple: The yearly dividend per share as a percentage of the share price.
definition.balanced: Dividend yield = dividend per share ÷ share price. It rises when the price falls, so a very high yield can be a sign that buyers expect the dividend to be cut. It is based on past payments, which are not promised.

example: Dividend 0.435 USD per share ÷ price 6.80 USD = about 6.4%.
